title: Man Leaning Against Wooden Door
coreRelationships: The man's figure is framed by the vertical lines of the wooden door and the horizontal lines of the door's metal band.
The strong diagonal shadow across the man's face and body creates a sense of depth and drama.
The texture of the wooden door and the brick wall provides a rustic backdrop that contrasts with the man's formal attire.
The man's upward gaze directs the viewer's eye towards the upper right portion of the frame, creating an open and thoughtful composition.
reuseFormula: Recreate a medium shot portrait of a man with dark skin and a beard, wearing a patterned blazer, white shirt, and dark tie. He should be leaning against a dark, rustic wooden door with horizontal metal bands, with a brick wall visible to his right. The man is looking upwards with a contemplative expression. Apply strong directional lighting from the upper left to create dramatic shadows across his face and body, and on the background. Overlay a black rectangular box with a thin white border in the top-left corner. Inside, place 'PARENTAL ADVISORY' in bold, white, uppercase sans-serif, and 'EXPLICIT CONTENT' below it in regular weight, white, uppercase sans-serif, both left-aligned.
